dlocErrSameDir: 新目录与当前数据目录相同,无需迁移
The new directory is the same as the current data directory; no migration is needed
dlocErrParentDir: 新目录不能是当前数据目录,也不能是它的上级目录(会递归复制)
The new directory cannot be the current data directory or one of its parent directories (data would be copied recursively)
dlocErrInsideCurrent: 新目录不能位于当前数据目录内(会递归复制)
The new directory cannot be inside the current data directory (data would be copied recursively)
dlocErrSystemDir: 不能使用系统关键目录(系统盘根 / Windows / Program Files / 用户主目录等)
Critical system directories are not allowed (system drive root, Windows, Program Files, user home directory, etc.)
dlocErrNotWritable: 目录不可写(权限不足或不可达)
The directory is not writable (insufficient permissions or unreachable)
dlocSpaceWarnN: 目标磁盘剩余空间不足(数据约 {need} MB,目标可用约 {have} MB),迁移可能失败
Not enough free space on the target disk (about {need} MB of data, about {have} MB available); migration may fail
dlocExistingNoteN: 目标目录非空(已有 {count} 项),迁移可能与既有文件混存。
The target directory is not empty ({count} items); migrated data may mix with existing files.
dlocErrSavePointer: 无法保存数据目录设置,请检查系统 AppData 目录权限后重试
Could not save the data directory setting; check the permissions of the system AppData directory and try again
dlocMigrationFailedBody: 迁移数据到 {to} 失败,数据仍保留在原位置 {from}。
Failed to migrate data to {to}; your data is still at the original location {from}.
dlocAltManagedByMain: 小号数据由主账号统一管理，不能单独迁移数据目录
Alt-account data is managed by the main account and cannot be migrated separately
dlocCloseRunningProfiles: 请先关闭正在运行的小号：{names}
Close the running alt accounts first: {names}
dlocInInstallDirMsg: 所选目录位于当前安装目录内
The selected directory is inside the current installation directory
dlocInInstallDirDetail: 后续版本覆盖安装时，系统会先卸载旧版本，存放在安装目录内的数据可能被删除。您确定要这么做吗？
When a newer version is installed, the old version is uninstalled first, and data stored inside the installation directory may be deleted. Are you sure you want to continue?
dlocAlreadyDefault: 当前已是默认数据目录
The current data directory is already the default one
dlocCloseAltWindows: 请先关闭所有小号窗口
Close all alt account windows first
bkErrUnsupported: 不是受支持的雨见备份文件
Not a supported Rainsee backup file
bkErrNoItems: 备份文件未包含可还原的数据
The backup file contains no restorable data
bkErrInvalidEntryPath: 备份文件包含无效路径
The backup file contains an invalid path
bkErrEscapePath: 备份文件包含越界路径
The backup file contains a path outside its root
bkErrEmptySelection: 请至少选择一项要备份的数据
Select at least one type of data to back up
bkChooseDirTitle: Choose where to save the backup
bkCreateFailedFull: 创建备份失败，请检查目录权限和剩余空间
Failed to create the backup; check the folder permissions and free disk space
bkRestoreAllData: 全部数据（包括 Cookie、书签、历史、密码和扩展）
All data (including cookies, bookmarks, history, passwords and extensions)
bkRestoreWarnMessage: Your current data is about to be overwritten
bkRestoreWarnDetail: 将还原：{items}。当前对应数据会被覆盖，此操作无法撤销；还原完成后需要立即重启浏览器。
The following will be restored: {items}. The corresponding current data will be overwritten and this cannot be undone; the browser must be restarted immediately after the restore.
bkRestoreFailed: Restore failed; please try again later
pnetErrSettingsOnly: 该操作只能从浏览器设置页执行
This action can only be performed from the browser settings page
pnetErrNoIp: 检测服务未返回出口 IP
The detection service did not return an exit IP
pnetErrTimeout: 连接超时，请检查代理地址和端口
Connection timed out; check the proxy address and port
pnetErrConnect: Could not connect to the proxy
pnetErrNotAltWindow: This is not an alt account window
pnetErrInvalidType: 请选择有效的代理类型
pnetErrPacRequired: 请提供 PAC 脚本或 URL
Provide a PAC script or URL
pnetErrPacMissingFn: PAC 脚本必须包含 FindProxyForURL 函数
The PAC script must define FindProxyForURL
pnetErrPacTooLong: The PAC script is too long
pnetErrBypassInvalid: 不代理地址列表格式不正确
The bypass list format is invalid
pnetErrHostRequired: 请输入代理服务器地址
pnetErrHostInvalid: 代理服务器地址格式不正确
The proxy server address format is invalid
pnetErrIpv6Brackets: IPv6 地址需要使用方括号，例如 [::1]
pnetErrPortRange: 代理端口必须在 1 到 65535 之间
The proxy port must be between 1 and 65535
pnetErrCredentialTooLong: The proxy username or password is too long
